DetectedFrameworkName.description: Framework names that can be auto-detected by `detectProjectOptions`. These are informational only — you still need to import and pass the actual framework config via `frameworks.<name>` in `eslintConfig()`.

DetectionOptions.description: Controls automatic project detection by category.

autoFrameworks.description: Enables bundled framework configs detected from dependencies. Disable this when you want manual framework control only.

detectRootDir.description: Root directory used for automatic project detection. Defaults to `process.cwd()`.

detectedFrameworks.description: Frameworks detected from package.json by `detectProjectOptions()`. In v2, `eslintConfig()` enables these bundled framework configs by default.

detection.description: Enables or disables automatic project detection by category. Use `false` to disable all detection, or an object for granular control.

extensions.description: List of specialized ESLint rules and extensions

features.description: Simple optional-config switchboard. Enables or disables entries from `extensions`, `formats`, `libraries`, `testing`, and `tools` using their string names. `integrations` is an alias for the same map.

formats.description: Additional non-JS/TS file formats to lint

frameworks.description:
Framework and library specific configurations.

Set a framework to `true` to use the bundled v2 config from `@santi020k/eslint-config-basic`, or pass a config array/factory when you need to override the bundled config.

react-router.description: New name for Remix projects on React Router v7+.

remix.deprecated: Remix merged into React Router v7 — use `react-router` instead.

ignores.description: Extra global ignore globs (flat config `ignores` only, no `files`). Patterns are relative to ESLint's working directory, like a manual ignore block. Not merged from presets or detection. For `projects` entries, patterns are not auto-prefixed with the subproject path; use repo-root-relative globs when needed.

optionMergeStrategy.description:
Controls how explicit arrays/frameworks combine with auto-detected and preset values.
- `merge` (default): union detected + preset + explicit values
- `replace`: explicit values fully replace detected/preset values

projects.description: Package-aware subproject configuration for monorepos. Each key is a workspace-relative folder and each value is scoped to that folder.

settings.description: List of global settings and behavioral flags

strict.description:
Severity profile.
- `false` / `recommended`: keep recommended severities
- `true` / `ci`: promote warnings to errors
- `pedantic`: promote warnings and enable built-in best-practice rules

testing.description: List of testing frameworks and testing environments

tools.description: List of integrations for external standalone tools

tsconfigRootDir.description: Root directory of the project. Required if multiple candidate TSConfigRootDirs are present.

typescript.description: Enable TypeScript support with optional settings

Extension.description: Enum for specialized ESLint extensions and strict rule sets

basePath.description:
The base path for files and ignores.

Note that this is not permitted inside an `extends` array.

Since ESLint 9.30.0

files.description: An array of glob patterns indicating the files that the configuration object should apply to. If not specified, the configuration object applies to all files matched by any other configuration object.

ignores.description: An array of glob patterns indicating the files that the configuration object should not apply to. If not specified, the configuration object applies to all files matched by files.

language.description: Language specifier in the form `namespace/language-name` where `namespace` is a plugin name set in the `plugins` field.

languageOptions.description: An object containing settings related to how JavaScript is configured for linting.

linterOptions.description: An object containing settings related to the linting process.

name.description: An string to identify the configuration object. Used in error messages and inspection tools.

plugins.description: An object containing a name-value mapping of plugin names to plugin objects. When `files` is specified, these plugins are only available to the matching files.

processor.description: Either an object containing `preprocess()` and `postprocess()` methods or a string indicating the name of a processor inside of a plugin (i.e., `"pluginName/processorName"`).

rules.description: An object containing the configured rules. When `files` or `ignores` are specified, these rule configurations are only available to the matching files.

settings.description: An object containing name-value pairs of information that should be available to all rules.

ecmaVersion.description: The version of ECMAScript to support. May be any year (i.e., `2022`) or version (i.e., `5`). Set to `"latest"` for the most recent supported version.

globals.description: An object specifying additional objects that should be added to the global scope during linting.

parser.description: An object containing a `parse()` method or a `parseForESLint()` method.

parserOptions.description: An object specifying additional options that are passed directly to the parser. The available options are parser-dependent.

sourceType.description: The type of JavaScript source code. Possible values are `"script"` for traditional script files, `"module"` for ECMAScript modules (ESM), and `"commonjs"` for CommonJS files.

noInlineConfig.description: A Boolean value indicating if inline configuration is allowed.

reportUnusedDisableDirectives.description: A severity string indicating if and how unused disable and enable directives should be tracked and reported. For legacy compatibility, `true` is equivalent to `"warn"` and `false` is equivalent to `"off"`.

reportUnusedInlineConfigs.description:
A severity string indicating if and how unused inline directives should be tracked and reported.

since ESLint 9.19.0

additionalProperties.description: We intentionally omit the `configs` key from this object because it avoids type conflicts with old plugins that haven't updated their configs to flat configs yet. It's valid to reference these old plugins because ESLint won't access the `.config` property of a plugin when evaluating a flat config.

meta.description: Metadata about your plugin for easier debugging and more effective caching of plugins.

name.description: The meta.name property should match the npm package name for your plugin.

namespace.description: If you followed the classic style to name your package (e.g. `eslint-plugin-X`, `@X/eslint-plugin`, or `@X/eslint-plugin-Y`), then this should match the classic namespace inferred for your package (e.g. `X`, `@X`, or `@X/Y`, respectively).

version.description: The meta.version property should match the npm package version for your plugin.

processors.description: The definition of plugin processors. Users can stringly reference the processor using the key in their config (i.e., `"pluginName/processorName"`).

rules.description: The definition of plugin rules. The key must be the name of the rule that users will use Users can stringly reference the rule using the key they registered the plugin under combined with the rule name. i.e. for the user config `plugins: { foo: pluginReference }` - the reference would be `"foo/ruleName"`.

FlatConfigArray.description: Type alias for ESLint flat config array

Format.description: Enum for linting non-JS/TS file formats

ImportedFramework.description: Type for framework option values: `true` enables the bundled v2 config, or pass a config array, a factory function, or an imported module with a default export. Any other value throws a descriptive `TypeError` (see `resolveFramework` in `@santi020k/eslint-config-basic`).

Library.description: Enum for application-level runtime dependencies and styling

LooseRuleDefinition.description:
A loose definition of the RuleModule type for use with configs. This type is intended to relax validation of types so that we can have basic validation without being overly strict about nitty gritty details matching.

For example the plugin might be declared using an old version of our types or they might use the DefinitelyTyped eslint types. Ultimately we don't need super strict validation in a config - a loose shape match is "good enough" to help validate the config is correct.

OptionalConfigMap.description: Simple opt-in/opt-out map for optional configs. Keys match the public enum string values, so both `features: { zod: true }` and `libraries: [Library.Zod]` resolve to the same underlying config.

meta.description: Information about the parser to uniquely identify it when serializing.

name.description: The unique name of the parser.

version.description: The a string identifying the version of the parser.

meta.description: Information about the parser to uniquely identify it when serializing.

name.description: The unique name of the parser.

version.description: The a string identifying the version of the parser.

Parser.LooseParserModule.description: A loose definition of the ParserModule type for use with configs This type intended to relax validation of configs so that parsers that have different AST types or scope managers can still be passed to configs

Processor.LooseProcessorModule.description: A loose definition of the ParserModule type for use with configs This type intended to relax validation of configs so that parsers that have different AST types or scope managers can still be passed to configs

meta.description: Information about the processor to uniquely identify it when serializing.

name.description: The unique name of the processor.

version.description: The a string identifying the version of the processor.

preprocess.description: The function to extract code blocks.

supportsAutofix.description: If `true` then it means the processor supports autofix.

ProjectServiceOptions.description: Granular options to configure the project service.

allowDefaultProject.description: Globs of files to allow running with the default project compiler options despite not being matched by the project service.

defaultProject.description: Path to a TSConfig to use instead of TypeScript's default project configuration.

loadTypeScriptPlugins.description: Whether to allow TypeScript plugins as configured in the TSConfig.

maximumDefaultProjectFileMatchCount_THIS.description: The maximum number of files  {@link  allowDefaultProject }  may match. Each file match slows down linting, so if you do need to use this, please file an informative issue on typescript-eslint explaining why - so we can help you avoid using it!

Setting.description: Enum for settings options in ESLint

SharedConfigurationSettings.description: Plugins can add their settings using declaration merging against this interface.

StrictMode.description: Severity profiles for teams adopting the config progressively.

Testing.description: Enum for testing frameworks and environments

Tool.description: Enum for integrating external standalone utilities
